title: nicandra physalodes
intro: Nicandra physalodes, commonly known as the "Shoo Fly Plant" or "Prickly Bitter Pea", is a species of flowering plant in the nightshade family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nicandra physalodes include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate gastrointestinal issues, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
